metadata.site_name: Strathspey Moorland & Agricultural Outpost near Aviemore

properties.description: High aerial vantage looking southwest across the expansive Strathspey basin towards the Monadhliath and Cairngorm foothills, looking down upon an isolated agricultural compound surrounded by grazing pasture and native heath.

properties.bedrock: Badenoch Group Psammite and Semipelite, Dalradian Supergroup metasediments intruded by Late Caledonian granitic complexes
properties.superficial_deposits: Glaciolacustrine and glaciofluvial sand and gravel hummocks over stony glacial till (Devensian glaciation)
properties.soil_profile: Peaty podzols and dystric rankers overlaid with humic moorland peat layers

properties.material: Compacted crushed granite and quartz trackway, rutted mud aprons, unpaved farm access roads cutting through meadow grass
properties.topography: Undulating river valley terrace rising gently towards glacial knolls

properties.biome: Cairngorms sub-montane pine and heather moorland mosaic
dominant_flora: Pinus sylvestris var. scotica (Caledonian Scots Pine stands in mid-distance)
Agrostis capillaris / Festuca ovina pasture grasses
Betula pubescens (Downy Birch fringes along drainage gullies)

properties.structures: Low-slung agricultural complex comprising steel-portal framed barns clad in profile corrugated metal sheets, weathered timber outbuildings, and traditional pitched-roof masonry storehouses with corrugated cement-fibre roofing.

properties.vehicles: Parked utility 4x4 vehicles and agricultural tractors on gravel pads
properties.ambient_elements: Occasional livestock grazing across fenced pasture paddocks

properties.sky_conditions: Crisp northern light under high broken stratocumulus; long shadows cast across heather-covered mountain shoulders
